# PUT /api/v1/user/starred/{owner}/{repo}

Star the given repo as the authenticated user

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-155`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **403** — Stars disabled by administrator OR user is blocked by repo owner
- **404** — Repo not found

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | user.Star | controller | Call repo_model.StarRepo with star=true |
| 2 | [models](../modules/models.md) | repo_model.StarRepo | repository | Check if user is blocked by repo owner; Check if already starring (idempotent); Insert star record; Increment repository.num_stars; Increment user.num_stars |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Stars must be enabled by administrator | authorization | setting.Repository.DisableStars is true |
| Starring is idempotent - starring an already-starred repo is a no-op | business_logic | star=true and already starring |
| Cannot star a repo if blocked by the repo owner | authorization | user_model.IsUserBlockedBy(ctx, doer, repo.OwnerID) |
| Star operation updates counters in a transaction (star table + repository.num_stars + user.num_stars) | business_logic | star=true and not already starring |
| Admin users bypass block checks when starring | authorization | blockee.IsAdmin is true |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| User blocked by repo owner | 403 | user is blocked | False |

### Error Paths

- **User blocked by repo owner** → user.Star → 403
- **DB error** → user.Star → 500
